notes: Interaction discipline (from field use: the installer was too verbose): it now narrates progress as it works in short lines — no long silences, no information dumps — asks every question that needs a decision ONE at a time, and keeps reports to the headline with full detail in the install record. The interview opens with a single choice: use the pack's defaults (then only the required questions are asked) or customize (each question asked singly). Also includes the interim ibuildwith.ai/skills endpoints (0.9.1), the hosting bridge (0.9.0), transactional self-update (0.8.1), folder-URL installs (0.8.0), and the Quality & Safety gate with mandatory integrity verification.
